def _restrict_runtime_syscalls(image_bytes):
    """Additional child-only restriction, not a replacement ptrace result.

    Only syscall instructions within the captured fixed-address native ELF
    are constrained here. Host pre-exec setup remains outside this additional
    test filter. Native file opens, process creation, further exec and W+X
    mappings kill the child. This is a scoped observation, not a sandbox claim.
    The original globally scoped failing observation remains separate.
    """
    class Filter(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('code', ctypes.c_ushort), ('jt', ctypes.c_ubyte),
                    ('jf', ctypes.c_ubyte), ('k', ctypes.c_uint)]
    class Program(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [('length', ctypes.c_ushort), ('filters', ctypes.POINTER(Filter))]
    labels, instructions = {}, []
    def label(name):
        labels[name] = len(instructions)
    def add(code, k, jt=0, jf=0):
        instructions.append((code, k, jt, jf))
    add(0x20, 4)  # seccomp_data.arch
    add(0x15, 0xc000003e, 0, 'kill')
    add(0x20, 12)  # seccomp_data.instruction_pointer high word
    add(0x15, 0, 0, 'allow')
    add(0x20, 8)  # low word, fixed ET_EXEC address range
    add(0x35, 0x400000, 0, 'allow')
    add(0x35, 0x400000 + image_bytes, 'allow', 0)
    add(0x20, 0)  # seccomp_data.nr, only after exact image-range admission
    for number in (2, 85, 257, 437, 56, 57, 58, 435, 59, 322):
        add(0x15, number, 'kill', 0)
    add(0x15, 9, 'protection', 0)
    add(0x15, 10, 'protection', 0)
    add(0x05, 'allow')
    label('protection')
    add(0x20, 32)  # args[2], mmap/mprotect protection
    add(0x54, 6)
    add(0x15, 6, 'kill', 'allow')
    label('kill')
    add(0x06, 0x80000000)
    label('allow')
    add(0x06, 0x7fff0000)
    values = []
    for index, (code, k, jt, jf) in enumerate(instructions):
        def offset(value):
            result = labels[value] - index - 1 if isinstance(value, str) else value
            assert 0 <= result <= 255
            return result
        values.append(Filter(code, offset(jt), offset(jf),
                             labels[k] - index - 1 if isinstance(k, str) else k))
    filters = (Filter * len(values))(*values)
    program = Program(len(values), filters)
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    def install():
        resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CORE, (0, 0))
        if libc.prctl(38, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS')
        if libc.prctl(22, 2, ctypes.byref(program), 0, 0) != 0:
            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_SECCOMP')
    return install


def bundle(files):
    result = bytearray(struct.pack('<3Q', BUNDLE_MAGIC, len(files), 0))
    for name, mode, data in files:
        name = name.encode('ascii') if isinstance(name, str) else name
        result += struct.pack('<3Q', len(name), mode, len(data)) + name + data
    return bytes(result)


def unpack(raw):
    """An independent HIAREL01 output oracle, never part of the native runtime."""
    import io
    stream = io.BytesIO(raw)
    header = stream.read(24)
    if len(raw) > WIRE_LIMIT or len(header) != 24:
        raise ValueError('wire extent')
    magic, count, reserved = struct.unpack('<3Q', header)
    if magic != BUNDLE_MAGIC or reserved or not 1 <= count <= 256:
        raise ValueError('header')
    result = {}
    for _ in range(count):
        fields = stream.read(24)
        if len(fields) != 24:
            raise ValueError('entry header')
        n, mode, size = struct.unpack('<3Q', fields)
        if not 1 <= n <= 127 or mode != 0o400 or not 1 <= size <= IMAGE_LIMIT:
            raise ValueError('entry limits')
        name = stream.read(n)
        if len(name) != n or re.fullmatch(rb'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*', name) is None or name in result:
            raise ValueError('name')
        data = stream.read(size)
        if len(data) != size:
            raise ValueError('payload')
        result[name] = data
    if stream.read():
        raise ValueError('trailing bytes')
    return result


def expected_elf(images):
    prefix, holes = template()
    policy, compiler, packer = images
    result = bytearray(prefix + policy + compiler + packer)
    struct.pack_into('<Q', result, 96, len(result))
    struct.pack_into('<Q', result, 104, len(result))
    for name, at in holes.items():
        offset = len(prefix)
        if name in ('compiler_hole', 'packer_hole'):
            offset += len(policy)
        if name == 'packer_hole':
            offset += len(compiler)
        struct.pack_into('<i', result, at, offset - at - 4)
    return bytes(result)


def workspace(**words):
    raw = bytearray(IMAGE_AT + 1)
    for name, value in words.items():
        struct.pack_into('<Q', raw, int(name[1:]), value)
    return raw


def observe_policy(wire, work, *, output=b'', output_size=64, offsets=(), work_offsets=()):
    body, owners, views = Body(0), [], []
    for data, extent in ((wire, len(wire)), (output, output_size), (work, POLICY_WORK_BYTES)):
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', extent)])
        owners.append(owner)
        view = body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for at, value in enumerate(data):
            if value:
                body.effect('buffer.store', [view, body.const('usize', at), body.const('u8', value)])
        if not views:
            body.effect('loan.end', [view])
            view = body.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        views.append(view)
    status = body.value('u32', 'call', views, {'function': 'f0'})
    values = [body.value('u8', 'buffer.load', [views[1], body.const('usize', at)]) for at in offsets]
    values += [body.value('u8', 'buffer.load', [views[2], body.const('usize', at)]) for at in work_offsets]
    for view in views:
        body.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners:
        body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    wrapper = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_build_reference\n'
               'fn observe() -> (' + ','.join(['u32'] + ['u8'] * len(values)) +
               ') effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n' + body.text() +
               '  ret(' + ','.join([status, *values]) + ')\nend\n' + POLICY.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    actual = execute_program(assemble_program(wrapper), 'observe', [], max_steps=4000000)
    assert actual['status'] == 'returned', actual
    return actual['values'][0], bytes(actual['values'][1:])


def vm_packer():
    images = (b'\xc3', b'\x90\xc3', b'\x90\x90\xc3')
    wire = struct.pack('<4Q', PACK_MAGIC, *map(len, images)) + b''.join(images)
    expected = expected_elf(images)
    b, owners, views = Body(0), [], []
    for data, extent in ((wire, len(wire)), (b'', len(expected)), (b'', 1), (expected, len(expected))):
        owner = b.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [b.const('usize', extent)])
        owners.append(owner)
        view = b.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for at, value in enumerate(data):
            if value:
                b.effect('buffer.store', [view, b.const('usize', at), b.const('u8', value)])
        if len(views) in (0, 3):
            b.effect('loan.end', [view])
            view = b.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        views.append(view)
    size = b.value('u32', 'call', views[:3], {'function': 'f0'})
    difference = b.value('u8', 'call', [views[1], views[3]], {'function': 'compare_all'})
    for view in views:
        b.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners:
        b.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    compare = '''def compare(o:mutbuf, s:readbuf) -> u8:
    i = 0
    difference = 0
    while i < length(s):
        difference = difference | (byte(o, i) ^ byte(s, i))
        i = i + 1
    return difference
'''
    compare = render_assembly(document(compare, 'comparison')).split('\n', 1)[1].replace('fn f0(', 'fn compare_all(')
    source = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_packer_reference\n'
              'fn observe() -> (u32,u8) effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n' +
              b.text() + '  ret(' + size + ',' + difference + ')\nend\n' + compare + PACKER.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    actual = execute_program(assemble_program(source), 'observe', [], max_steps=4000000)
    assert actual['status'] == 'returned' and actual['values'] == [len(expected), 0], actual

                                capture_output=True, env={'PATH': ''}, cwd=self.case, timeout=timeout)
        self.observations.append({'case': self.id(), 'operation': operation,
                                  'input_sha256': sha256(wire).hexdigest(), 'input_bytes': len(wire),
                                  'executable_sha256': sha256(before).hexdigest(),
                                  'returncode': result.returncode, 'output_bytes': len(result.stdout),
                                  'output_sha256': sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),

        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), before)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, code, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b'')

    def test_real_EPIPE_after_a_written_prefix_exits_with_io_status(self):
        strace = shutil.which('strace')
        self.assertIsNotNone(strace)
        opaque = bytes([0x5a]) * IMAGE_LIMIT
        wire = bundle([(name + '.bin', 0o400, opaque) for name in ROLE_NAMES])
        input_path, log = self.case / 'input.bin', self.case / 'write-syscalls.log'
        input_path.write_bytes(wire)
        with input_path.open('rb') as source:
            process = subprocess.Popen([strace, '-o', str(log), '-e', 'trace=write', str(self.app), 'pack'],
                                       stdin=source, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                       env={'PATH': ''}, cwd=self.case, start_new_session=True)
            completed = False
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 30
            try:
                prefix = bytearray()
                descriptor = process.stdout.fileno()
                os.set_blocking(descriptor, False)
                with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector:
                    selector.register(descriptor, selectors.EVENT_READ)
                    while len(prefix) < 4096:
                        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
                        if remaining <= 0 or not selector.select(remaining):
                            raise TimeoutError('native EPIPE control did not publish a prefix before its deadline')
                        try:
                            chunk = os.read(descriptor, 4096 - len(prefix))
                        except BlockingIOError:
                            continue
                        if not chunk:
                            break
                        prefix += chunk
                self.assertEqual(len(prefix), 4096)
                process.stdout.close()
                process.stdout = None
                _, error = process.communicate(timeout=max(0.001, deadline - time.monotonic()))
                code = process.returncode
                completed = True
            finally:
                try:
                    if not completed:
                        # Popen created this invocation's own session/group.
                        # Kill both tracer and tracee before reaping the leader.
                        try:
                            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                        except ProcessLookupError:
                            pass
                        process.wait(timeout=10)
                finally:
                    if process.stdout is not None:
                        process.stdout.close()
                    process.stderr.close()
        self.assertEqual((code, error), (15, b''))
        self.assertEqual(prefix, expected_elf((opaque,) * 3)[:4096])
        trace = log.read_text()
        self.assertIn('EPIPE', trace)
        self.assertRegex(trace, r'write\(1,.*\)\s+= [1-9][0-9]*')
        self.observations.append({'kernel_write_failure': 'EPIPE', 'prefix_bytes': len(prefix),
                                  'returncode': code, 'syscall_trace_sha256': sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

                self.assertGreater(len(expected), capacity+4096)
                os.set_blocking(descriptor, False)
                with selectors.DefaultSelector() as selector:

                    while len(prefix)<4096:

                        try:

class PublicationUnionCustodyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_closed(self, fd):
        with self.assertRaises(OSError) as caught:
            os.fstat(fd)
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.errno, errno.EBADF)

    def test_actual_returned_process_keeps_structured_refusal_and_never_replays(self):
        import hepta.artifact_publication_native as native
        from hepta.artifact_publication import PublicationRejected
        from tests.test_hia_program_selfhost import _test_executable
        code = _test_executable(bytes.fromhex("b83c000000bf0c0000000f05"))
        original_run = subprocess.run
        for operation in native.NATIVE_PUBLICATION_OPERATIONS:
            observed = []
            def inspect_and_run(argv, **kwargs):
                fd = int(argv[0].rsplit("/", 1)[1])
                observed.append(fd)
                self.assertEqual(fcntl.fcntl(fd, 1034) & 15, 15)
                self.assertEqual(os.pread(fd, len(code) + 1, 0), code)
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["pass_fds"], (fd,))
                return original_run(argv, **kwargs)
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                with (patch.object(native, "_validated_code", return_value=code),
                      patch.object(native.subprocess, "run", side_effect=inspect_and_run) as run):
                    with self.assertRaises(native.NativePublicationRefusal) as caught:
                        native._execute_native("selected", operation, "stage", "dest", b"")
                    self.assertIsInstance(caught.exception, PublicationRejected)
                    self.assertEqual(caught.exception.operation, operation)
                    self.assertEqual(caught.exception.returncode, 12)
                    self.assertEqual(str(caught.exception), "E_PUBLISH_RACE: native " + operation
                                     + " refused or I/O failed; no automatic replay")
                    run.assert_called_once()
                self.assertEqual(len(observed), 1)
                self.assert_closed(observed[0])

    def test_real_sealed_wrong_extent_or_bytes_refuse_before_child(self):
        import hepta.artifact_publication_native as native
        from hepta.artifact_publication import PublicationRejected
        code = b"captured-executable-fixture"
        write = os.write
        for changed in (code[:-1], bytes([code[0] ^ 1]) + code[1:]):
            descriptors = []
            def corrupt_real_write(fd, data):
                descriptors.append(fd)
                written = write(fd, changed)
                self.assertEqual(written, len(changed))
                return len(data)
            with self.subTest(changed=changed):
                with (patch.object(native, "_validated_code", return_value=code),
                      patch.object(native.os, "write", side_effect=corrupt_real_write),
                      patch.object(native.subprocess, "run") as run):
                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(PublicationRejected, "E_PUBLISH_NATIVE_CUSTODY"):
                        native._execute_native("selected", "withdraw", "stage", "dest", b"")
                    run.assert_not_called()
                self.assertEqual(len(descriptors), 1)
                self.assert_closed(descriptors[0])

"""Build an explicitly selected, syscall-only JSON Core compiler filter.

The trusted build driver binds a completed cold compiler and frontend bytes.
ELF layout/call relocation/image packing are done by the compiled HIA packer.
The delivered executable parses/verifies/compiles stdin without Python or ld.
This does not activate or replace the full production command surface.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct

import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from tools.generate_hia_core_json_cli import MAGIC, LIMIT
from tools.build_hia_json_preflight import (admit_cold_build, current_sources,
                                           build as build_frontend)
from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import compile_stage, invoke
from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_cli import inspect_executable

SOURCE = ROOT/'examples/hia_bootstrap/core_json_cli_packer.hiaasm'


def build(output: Path, compiler: Path, cold_report: Path, *, output_profile='flat') -> Path:
    if type(output_profile) is not str or output_profile not in ('flat','elf','exec'):
        raise ValueError('unknown native JSON CLI output profile')
    compiler_raw, cold_raw, packer_source = compiler.read_bytes(), cold_report.read_bytes(), SOURCE.read_bytes()
    frontend_source = (ROOT/'examples/hia_bootstrap/core_json_frontend.hiaasm').read_bytes()
    admitted_sources = admit_cold_build(compiler_raw, cold_raw)
    if (admitted_sources.get(SOURCE.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()) != sha256(packer_source).hexdigest()
            or admitted_sources.get('examples/hia_bootstrap/core_json_frontend.hiaasm') != sha256(frontend_source).hexdigest()):
        raise ValueError('native JSON CLI source differs from admitted cold source')
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    frontend_manifest = build_frontend(output/'frontend', compiler, cold_report, candidate='core-frontend')
    frontend_manifest_raw = frontend_manifest.read_bytes()
    metadata = json.loads(frontend_manifest_raw)
    frontend = frontend_manifest.parent/metadata['image_path']
    frontend_raw = frontend.read_bytes()
    packer, compile_receipt = compile_stage(output, 'native-packer', compiler, packer_source)
    packer_raw = packer.read_bytes()
    frame = struct.pack('<4Q', MAGIC, len(frontend_raw), len(compiler_raw),
                        ('flat','elf','exec').index(output_profile))
    frame += frontend_raw + compiler_raw
    if len(frame) > LIMIT:
        raise ValueError('qualified images exceed unchanged packer source capacity')
    result, packed = invoke(output, 'native-pack', packer, frame)
    if (result.get('status') != 'returned'
            or type(result.get('abi_status')) is not int or result['abi_status'] != 0
            or type(result.get('core_u32')) is not int
            or not 0 < result['core_u32'] <= LIMIT
            or result['core_u32'] != len(packed[:result['core_u32']])
            or result.get('image_sha256') != sha256(packer_raw).hexdigest()
            or result.get('source_sha256') != sha256(frame).hexdigest()
            or result.get('source_unchanged') is not True):
        raise ValueError('native HIA packer rejected image frame')
    executable_bytes = packed[:result['core_u32']]
    inspection = inspect_executable(executable_bytes)
    if (compiler.read_bytes() != compiler_raw or cold_report.read_bytes() != cold_raw
            or SOURCE.read_bytes() != packer_source or frontend.read_bytes() != frontend_raw
            or packer.read_bytes() != packer_raw or frontend_manifest.read_bytes() != frontend_manifest_raw
            or (ROOT/'examples/hia_bootstrap/core_json_frontend.hiaasm').read_bytes() != frontend_source
            or sha256(frontend_raw).hexdigest() != metadata['image_sha256']
            or current_sources() != admitted_sources):
        raise ValueError('native JSON CLI build inputs changed')
    executable = output/'hia-core-json'
    executable.write_bytes(executable_bytes)
    executable.chmod(0o700)
    report = {'schema':'hepta.hia.core-json-cli-build.v1', 'status':'NATIVE_JSON_CLI_BUILT',
        'output_profile':output_profile, 'executable':inspection,
        'compiler_sha256':sha256(compiler_raw).hexdigest(),
        'frontend_sha256':sha256(frontend_raw).hexdigest(),
        'frontend_source_sha256':sha256(frontend_source).hexdigest(),
        'packer_source_sha256':sha256(packer_source).hexdigest(),
        'packer_sha256':sha256(packer_raw).hexdigest(),
        'cold_report_sha256':sha256(cold_raw).hexdigest(),
        'frame_sha256':sha256(frame).hexdigest(),
        'native_compile_receipt':compile_receipt, 'native_pack_receipt':result,
        'runtime_Python_or_host_payload_parser_required':False,
        'host_filesystem_build_and_evidence_driver':True,
        'production_activated':False, 'whole_production_cli_replaced':False,
        'whole_stack_rewritten_in_hia':False}
    (output/'build.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    if output_profile == 'elf':
        from hepta.hia_program_selfhost import SOURCE_FILES, manifest_value
        selection = manifest_value(executable,
            compiler_sha256=report['compiler_sha256'], frontend_sha256=report['frontend_sha256'],
            packer_sha256=report['packer_sha256'], cold_report_sha256=report['cold_report_sha256'],
            source_sha256={name: admitted_sources[name] for name in SOURCE_FILES})
        if (executable.read_bytes() != executable_bytes
                or current_sources() != admitted_sources):
            raise ValueError('native JSON compiler selection changed before publication')
        with (output/'compiler-manifest.json').open('x') as stream:
            stream.write(json.dumps(selection, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')
    return executable


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--compiler', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--cold-report', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output-profile', choices=('flat','elf','exec'), default='flat')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(build(args.output.resolve(), args.compiler.resolve(), args.cold_report.resolve(),
                output_profile=args.output_profile))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Build a source-bound HIA native release installer from a qualified compiler.

This remains the explicit hosted bootstrap/custody driver. The produced ELF
installs and verifies packages without Python, libc or another executable.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:

    'examples/hia_bootstrap/sha256_stream.hiaasm',
    'tools/generate_hia_release_install.py',
    'tools/hia_release_install_syscalls.S',
    'tools/build_hia_release_install.py',
)


def build(output: Path, compiler: Path, cold_report: Path):
    compiler_bytes, cold_bytes = compiler.read_bytes(), cold_report.read_bytes()
    source_bytes = {name: (ROOT/name).read_bytes() for name in SOURCES}
    admitted = admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes, cold_bytes)
    if any(admitted.get(name) != sha256(raw).hexdigest() for name, raw in source_bytes.items()):
        raise ValueError('release installer source missing from matching cold contract')
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    images, receipts = {}, {}
    for label, name in zip(('policy', 'packer', 'sha256'), SOURCES[:3]):
        image, receipts[label] = compile_stage(output, label, compiler, source_bytes[name])
        images[label] = (image, image.read_bytes())
    policy, sha = images['policy'][1], images['sha256'][1]
    frame = struct.pack('<3Q', MAGIC, len(policy), len(sha)) + policy + sha
    result, packed = invoke(output, 'release-pack', images['packer'][0], frame)
    size = result.get('core_u32')
    if result.get('status') != 'returned' or type(size) is not int or not 0 < size <= len(packed):
        raise ValueError('native HIA release packer refused image frame')
    raw = packed[:size]
    inspection = inspect_executable(raw)
    if (compiler.read_bytes() != compiler_bytes or cold_report.read_bytes() != cold_bytes
            or any((ROOT/name).read_bytes() != data for name, data in source_bytes.items())
            or any(path.read_bytes() != data for path, data in images.values())
            or current_sources() != admitted):
        raise ValueError('release installer inputs changed before publication')
    executable = output/'hia-release'
    with executable.open('xb') as stream:

        'image_sha256': {name: sha256(data).hexdigest() for name, (_, data) in images.items()},
        'executable_path': executable.name, 'executable_sha256': sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        'executable': inspection, 'compile_receipts': receipts, 'pack_receipt': result,
        'runtime_python_or_libc_or_child_required': False,
        'host_build_and_code_custody': True,
        'explicit_linux_x86_64_syscall_adapter': True,
        'operator_expected_package_sha256_required': True,
        'release_publication_no_replace': True,
        'failed_stages_retained': True,
        'default_activation_or_worker_migration': False,
        'complete_native_build_or_release_lifecycle': False,
        'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False,
    }
    with (output/'build.json').open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
        stream.write('\n')
    return executable


def main():

        parser.add_argument('--'+name, type=Path, required=True)

DEVELOPMENT_INPUT_NAMES = REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES + (
    'hepta/hia_json_preflight_native.py',
    'hepta/hia_agent_assembly.py',
    'tools/build_hia_core_json_bytes.py',
    'tools/build_hia_json_preflight.py',
    'tools/qualify_hia_selfhost.py',
    'tools/hia_selfhost_contract.py',
    'tools/generate_hia_selfhost.py',
    'tools/generate_hia_sha256.py',
)


def _digest(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def _encoded(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n').encode('utf-8')


def _pairs(items):
    result = {}
    for key, value in items:
        if key in result:
            raise ValueError('duplicate source-admission build receipt field')
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _publish(path, raw):
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(raw)
        stream.flush()
    if path.read_bytes() != raw:
        raise ValueError('source-admission publication readback differs: ' + path.name)


def _build(output, compiler, compiler_bytes, source_bytes, consumed, recheck,
           *, scope, cold_bytes=None, sources=None):
    """Fixed compiler transport shared by two separately admitted entries."""
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    image, receipt = compile_stage(output, LABEL, compiler, source_bytes)
    image = Path(image)
    if image.parent != output or image.name != LABEL + '.image.bin':
        raise ValueError('source-admission compiler published an unexpected image path')
    image_bytes = image.read_bytes()
    admit_compile_receipt(receipt, compiler_bytes=compiler_bytes,
                          source_bytes=source_bytes, image_bytes=image_bytes)
    if receipt.get('case') != LABEL or receipt.get('produced_image') != str(image):
        raise ValueError('source-admission compile receipt names a different invocation or image')
    receipt_path = output / (LABEL + '.receipt.json')
    receipt_bytes = receipt_path.read_bytes()
    recorded = json.loads(receipt_bytes, object_pairs_hook=_pairs)
    admit_compile_receipt(recorded, compiler_bytes=compiler_bytes,
                          source_bytes=source_bytes, image_bytes=image_bytes)
    if _encoded(recorded) != _encoded(receipt):
        raise ValueError('source-admission compile receipt readback differs')
    consumed[image], consumed[receipt_path] = image_bytes, receipt_bytes
    recheck()
    manifest = {'schema': SCHEMA, 'source_sha256': _digest(source_bytes),
                'image_path': image.name, 'image_sha256': _digest(image_bytes),
                'compiler_sha256': _digest(compiler_bytes)}
    filename = 'manifest.json' if cold_bytes is not None else 'development-manifest.json'
    manifest_path = output / filename
    manifest_bytes = _encoded(manifest)
    _publish(manifest_path, manifest_bytes)
    consumed[manifest_path] = manifest_bytes
    recheck()
    report = {
        'schema': BUILD_SCHEMA, 'status': 'NATIVE_CANDIDATE_BUILT', 'scope': scope,
        'manifest': manifest, 'native_compile_receipt': receipt,
        'native_compile_receipt_sha256': _digest(receipt_bytes),
        'component_sources': {name: _digest(consumed[ROOT / name])
                              for name in REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES},
        'cold_report_sha256': None if cold_bytes is None else _digest(cold_bytes),
        'source_manifest': sources,
        'production_activated': False, 'default_source_admission_replaced': False,
        'all_input_equivalence_proved': False, 'whole_stack_rewritten_in_hia': False,
        'foreign_filesystem_transport_is_python': True,
        'original_compiler_child_timeout_seconds': 20,
    }
    if cold_bytes is None:
        report['development_input_manifest'] = {
            name: _digest(consumed[ROOT / name]) for name in DEVELOPMENT_INPUT_NAMES}
    else:
        from tools.hia_selfhost_contract import PROFILE
        report['profile'] = PROFILE
    report_path = output / ('build.json' if cold_bytes is not None else 'development-build.json')
    report_bytes = _encoded(report)
    _publish(report_path, report_bytes)
    consumed[report_path] = report_bytes
    recheck()
    return manifest_path


def build(output: Path, compiler: Path, cold_report: Path) -> Path:
    """Production build: no missing/old/partial cold or development fallback."""
    output, compiler, cold_report = (Path(p).resolve() for p in (output, compiler, cold_report))
    compiler_bytes, cold_bytes = compiler.read_bytes(), cold_report.read_bytes()
    sources = admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes, cold_bytes)
    component = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES}
    if any(sources.get(name) != _digest(raw) for name, raw in component.items()):
        raise ValueError('source-admission inputs are outside the complete matching cold source contract')
    consumed = {compiler: compiler_bytes, cold_report: cold_bytes,
                **{ROOT / name: raw for name, raw in component.items()}}

    def recheck():
        if (any(path.read_bytes() != raw for path, raw in consumed.items())
                or current_sources() != sources):
            raise ValueError('source-admission build inputs, receipts or published bytes changed')

    recheck()
    return _build(output, compiler, compiler_bytes, component[SOURCE_NAME], consumed, recheck,
                  scope='MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD', cold_bytes=cold_bytes, sources=sources)


def build_development(output: Path, compiler: Path) -> Path:
    """Explicit retained compiler experiment; never called by production build."""
    output, compiler = (Path(p).resolve() for p in (output, compiler))
    compiler_bytes = compiler.read_bytes()
    component = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in DEVELOPMENT_INPUT_NAMES}
    consumed = {compiler: compiler_bytes,
                **{ROOT / name: raw for name, raw in component.items()}}

    def recheck():
        if any(path.read_bytes() != raw for path, raw in consumed.items()):
            raise ValueError('source-admission development input or output bytes changed')

    recheck()
    return _build(output, compiler, compiler_bytes, component[SOURCE_NAME], consumed, recheck,
                  scope='EXPLICIT_COMPILER_DEVELOPMENT_COMPONENT')


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--compiler', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    selection = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    selection.add_argument('--cold-report', type=Path)
    selection.add_argument('--development', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = (build_development(args.output, args.compiler) if args.development
            else build(args.output, args.compiler, args.cold_report))
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'NATIVE_CANDIDATE_BUILT', 'manifest': str(path),
                      'scope': 'DEVELOPMENT' if args.development else 'MATCHING_SOURCE_COLD'}))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Bootstrap a standalone HIA assembly source builder from a cold compiler.

This Python command is an explicit bootstrap/custody boundary. Its resulting
ELF owns bundle admission, compilation and self-repacking without Python, libc,
an assembler, a filesystem lookup or another executable at runtime.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import fcntl
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import struct
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if __package__ in {None, ''}:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))

from tools.build_hia_json_preflight import admit_cold_build, current_sources
from tools.generate_hia_source_build import BUNDLE_MAGIC, PACK_MAGIC, ROLE_NAMES, LAYOUT
from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost import compile_stage, invoke
from tools.hia_selfhost_contract import PROFILE
from tools.qualify_hia_selfhost_cli import inspect_executable

SOURCES = (
    'examples/hia_bootstrap/source_build_policy.hiaasm',
    'examples/hia_bootstrap/selfhost.hiaasm',
    'examples/hia_bootstrap/source_build_packer.hiaasm',
    'tools/generate_hia_source_build.py',
    'tools/hia_source_build_syscalls.S',
    'tools/build_hia_source_build.py',
)


def _check_call_receipt(receipt, *, artifact, source, size):
    expected_artifact, expected_source = sha256(artifact).hexdigest(), sha256(source).hexdigest()
    if (receipt.get('status') != 'returned' or type(receipt.get('abi_status')) is not int or receipt['abi_status'] != 0
            or type(receipt.get('core_u32')) is not int or receipt['core_u32'] != size
            or receipt.get('artifact_sha256') != expected_artifact
            or receipt.get('image_sha256') != expected_artifact
            or receipt.get('input_sha256') != expected_source
            or receipt.get('source_sha256') != expected_source
            or type(receipt.get('input_bytes')) is not int or receipt['input_bytes'] != len(source)
            or receipt.get('source_unchanged') is not True
            or receipt.get('forbidden_compiler_modules_loaded') != []):
        raise ValueError('actual native call identity does not match captured inputs')


def _check_compile_receipt(receipt, *, compiler, source, produced):
    _check_call_receipt(receipt, artifact=compiler, source=source, size=len(produced))
    if (not 0 < len(produced) <= 1 << 20
            or type(receipt.get('produced_bytes')) is not int
            or receipt['produced_bytes'] != len(produced)
            or receipt.get('produced_sha256') != sha256(produced).hexdigest()):
        raise ValueError('native compile receipt does not bind actual produced bytes')


def _source_bundle(sources):
    """Bootstrap transport only; the native policy independently admits all bytes."""
    wire = bytearray(struct.pack('<3Q', BUNDLE_MAGIC, 3, 0))
    for name, raw in zip(ROLE_NAMES, sources):
        name = name.encode('ascii')
        wire += struct.pack('<3Q', len(name), 0o400, len(raw)) + name + raw
    return bytes(wire)


def _run_captured(executable, operation, wire, directory):
    """Execute a sealed descriptor; a pathname swap cannot select other code."""
    fd = os.memfd_create('hia-source-build-bootstrap', os.MFD_ALLOW_SEALING)
    try:
        at = 0
        while at < len(executable):
            count = os.write(fd, executable[at:])
            if count <= 0:
                raise OSError('short native bootstrap image write')
            at += count
        fcntl.fcntl(fd, getattr(fcntl, 'F_ADD_SEALS', 1033), 15)
        if fcntl.fcntl(fd, getattr(fcntl, 'F_GET_SEALS', 1034)) & 15 != 15:
            raise ValueError('native bootstrap descriptor was not sealed')
        return subprocess.run(['/proc/self/fd/' + str(fd), operation], input=wire,
                              capture_output=True, env={'PATH': ''}, cwd=directory,
                              timeout=120, pass_fds=(fd,))
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def _publish_captured(directory, executable, report, *, sourcekit=None):
    """Publish captured output bytes from retained anonymous descriptors.

    O_TMPFILE plus /proc/self/fd and an explicit destination dirfd makes Python
    issue linkat(AT_SYMLINK_FOLLOW). The input inode is selected by our retained
    descriptor, and the destination is created without replacement. Success
    metadata is written only after every requested inode and its bytes are
    verified. The optional keyword keeps existing executable-only callers valid.
    """
    if sourcekit is not None and (type(sourcekit) is not bytes or not 0 < len(sourcekit) <= 64 << 20):
        raise ValueError('captured sourcekit must contain bounded exact bytes')
    dfd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC)
    fd = receipt_fd = sourcekit_fd = -1
    linked = sourcekit_linked = False
    directory_stat = os.fstat(dfd)
    def same_inode(left, right):
        return (left.st_dev, left.st_ino) == (right.st_dev, right.st_ino)
    def write_all(target, data):
        at = 0
        while at < len(data):
            count = os.write(target, data[at:])
            if count <= 0:
                raise OSError('short captured publication write')
            at += count
    def verify_current():
        image_stat = os.fstat(fd)
        named_stat = os.stat('hia-source-build', dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if (not same_inode(image_stat, named_stat) or not stat.S_ISREG(named_stat.st_mode)
                or image_stat.st_size != len(executable) or stat.S_IMODE(image_stat.st_mode) != 0o500
                or image_stat.st_nlink != 1
                or not same_inode(directory_stat, os.stat(directory, follow_symlinks=False))
                or os.pread(fd, len(executable) + 1, 0) != executable):
            raise ValueError('published executable descriptor or bytes changed')
        return image_stat
    def verify_sourcekit():
        kit_stat = os.fstat(sourcekit_fd)
        named_stat = os.stat('sourcekit.bin', dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=False)
        if (not same_inode(kit_stat, named_stat) or not stat.S_ISREG(named_stat.st_mode)
                or kit_stat.st_size != len(sourcekit) or stat.S_IMODE(kit_stat.st_mode) != 0o400
                or kit_stat.st_nlink != 1
                or not same_inode(directory_stat, os.stat(directory, follow_symlinks=False))
                or os.pread(sourcekit_fd, len(sourcekit) + 1, 0) != sourcekit):
            raise ValueError('published sourcekit descriptor or bytes changed')
        return kit_stat
    def remove_owned(name, owned_fd):
        if owned_fd < 0:
            return
        try:
            current = os.stat(name, dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=False)
            if same_inode(current, os.fstat(owned_fd)):
                os.unlink(name, dir_fd=dfd)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
    try:
        fd = os.open('.', os.O_TMPFILE | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600, dir_fd=dfd)
        write_all(fd, executable)
        os.fchmod(fd, 0o500)
        os.fsync(fd)
        if os.pread(fd, len(executable) + 1, 0) != executable or os.fstat(fd).st_nlink != 0:
            raise ValueError('anonymous publication inode differs from captured executable')
        if sourcekit is not None:
            sourcekit_fd = os.open('.', os.O_TMPFILE | os.O_RDWR | os.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600, dir_fd=dfd)
            write_all(sourcekit_fd, sourcekit)
            os.fchmod(sourcekit_fd, 0o400)
            os.fsync(sourcekit_fd)
            if (os.pread(sourcekit_fd, len(sourcekit) + 1, 0) != sourcekit
                    or os.fstat(sourcekit_fd).st_nlink != 0):
                raise ValueError('anonymous publication inode differs from captured sourcekit')
        os.link('/proc/self/fd/' + str(fd), 'hia-source-build',
                dst_dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=True)
        linked = True
        if sourcekit is not None:
            os.link('/proc/self/fd/' + str(sourcekit_fd), 'sourcekit.bin',
                    dst_dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=True)
            sourcekit_linked = True
        image_stat = verify_current()
        binding = {'device': image_stat.st_dev, 'inode': image_stat.st_ino,
                   'mode': stat.S_IMODE(image_stat.st_mode), 'size': image_stat.st_size,
                   'sha256': sha256(executable).hexdigest(),
                   'directory_device': directory_stat.st_dev, 'directory_inode': directory_stat.st_ino,
                   'source': 'O_TMPFILE retained descriptor', 'no_replace': True}
        recorded = {**report, 'publication': binding}
        if sourcekit is not None:
            kit_stat = verify_sourcekit()
            kit_binding = {'device': kit_stat.st_dev, 'inode': kit_stat.st_ino,
                           'mode': stat.S_IMODE(kit_stat.st_mode), 'size': kit_stat.st_size,
                           'sha256': sha256(sourcekit).hexdigest(),
                           'directory_device': directory_stat.st_dev, 'directory_inode': directory_stat.st_ino,
                           'source': 'O_TMPFILE retained descriptor', 'no_replace': True}
            recorded.update(sourcekit_path='sourcekit.bin', sourcekit_sha256=kit_binding['sha256'],
                            sourcekit_publication=kit_binding)
        serialized = (json.dumps(recorded, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode()
        receipt_fd = os.open('build.json', os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_CLOEXEC,
                             0o400, dir_fd=dfd)
        write_all(receipt_fd, serialized)
        os.fsync(receipt_fd)
        verify_current()
        if sourcekit is not None:
            verify_sourcekit()
        receipt_stat = os.fstat(receipt_fd)
        if (not same_inode(receipt_stat, os.stat('build.json', dir_fd=dfd, follow_symlinks=False))
                or receipt_stat.st_nlink != 1 or stat.S_IMODE(receipt_stat.st_mode) != 0o400
                or os.pread(receipt_fd, len(serialized) + 1, 0) != serialized):
            raise ValueError('published receipt descriptor or bytes changed')
        os.fsync(dfd)
        return binding
    except BaseException:
        remove_owned('build.json', receipt_fd)
        if sourcekit_linked:
            remove_owned('sourcekit.bin', sourcekit_fd)
        if linked:
            remove_owned('hia-source-build', fd)
        raise
    finally:
        if receipt_fd >= 0:
            os.close(receipt_fd)
        if sourcekit_fd >= 0:
            os.close(sourcekit_fd)
        if fd >= 0:
            os.close(fd)
        os.close(dfd)


def build(output: Path, compiler: Path, cold_report: Path):
    compiler_bytes, cold_bytes = compiler.read_bytes(), cold_report.read_bytes()
    source_bytes = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in SOURCES}
    admitted = admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes, cold_bytes)
    if any(admitted.get(name) != sha256(raw).hexdigest() for name, raw in source_bytes.items()):
        raise ValueError('source builder source missing from matching cold contract')
    if not 0 < len(compiler_bytes) <= 1 << 20:
        raise ValueError('compiler image exceeds the retained image limit')
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    # The actual compiler path passed to every child contains captured bytes.
    # Per-call receipts bind the bytes actually loaded, catching even a
    # temporary swap restored before the final pathname readback.
    pinned_compiler = output / 'captured-compiler.image.bin'
    pinned_compiler.write_bytes(compiler_bytes)
    pinned_compiler.chmod(0o400)
    images, receipts = {}, {}
    for label, name in (('policy', SOURCES[0]), ('packer', SOURCES[2])):
        path, receipt = compile_stage(output, label, pinned_compiler, source_bytes[name])
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        _check_compile_receipt(receipt, compiler=compiler_bytes, source=source_bytes[name], produced=raw)
        images[label] = (path, raw)
        receipts[label] = receipt
    policy, packer = images['policy'][1], images['packer'][1]
    frame = struct.pack('<4Q', PACK_MAGIC, len(policy), len(compiler_bytes), len(packer)) + policy + compiler_bytes + packer
    receipt, packed = invoke(output, 'bootstrap-pack', images['packer'][0], frame)
    size = receipt.get('core_u32')
    if type(size) is not int or not 0 < size <= len(packed):
        raise ValueError('HIA source-builder packer refused the bootstrap frame')
    _check_call_receipt(receipt, artifact=packer, source=frame, size=size)
    if receipt.get('output_sha256') != sha256(packed).hexdigest():
        raise ValueError('packer output bytes do not match the actual receipt')
    executable_bytes = packed[:size]
    inspection = inspect_executable(executable_bytes)
    wire = _source_bundle([source_bytes[name] for name in SOURCES[:3]])
    built = _run_captured(executable_bytes, 'build', wire, output)
    if built.returncode or built.stderr:
        raise ValueError('native source-kit compilation refused the captured source bundle')
    rebuilt = _run_captured(executable_bytes, 'pack', built.stdout, output)
    if rebuilt.returncode or rebuilt.stderr or rebuilt.stdout != executable_bytes:
        raise ValueError('native source-kit identity and self-repack do not reproduce the executable')
    if (compiler.read_bytes() != compiler_bytes or cold_report.read_bytes() != cold_bytes
            or pinned_compiler.read_bytes() != compiler_bytes
            or any((ROOT / name).read_bytes() != raw for name, raw in source_bytes.items())
            or any(path.read_bytes() != raw for path, raw in images.values())
            or current_sources() != admitted):
        raise ValueError('source builder inputs changed before publication')
    executable = output / 'hia-source-build'
    report = {
        'schema': 'hepta.hia.source-build-bootstrap.v1',
        'status': 'NATIVE_SOURCE_BUILDER_BUILT',
        'source_manifest': admitted,
        'source_sha256': {name: sha256(raw).hexdigest() for name, raw in source_bytes.items()},
        'compiler_sha256': sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest(),
        'cold_report_sha256': sha256(cold_bytes).hexdigest(),
        'image_sha256': {name: sha256(raw).hexdigest() for name, (_, raw) in images.items()},
        'compile_receipts': receipts, 'pack_receipt': receipt,
        'executable_path': executable.name, 'executable_sha256': sha256(executable_bytes).hexdigest(),
        'executable': inspection, 'sourcekit_sha256': sha256(built.stdout).hexdigest(),
        'native_self_repack_equal': True, 'memory_layout': LAYOUT,
        'input_and_output_limit': 64 << 20, 'source_and_image_limit': 1 << 20,
        'runtime_python_or_libc_or_child_required': False,
        'runtime_source_compile_dispatch_owned_by_HIA': True,
        'retained_compiler_profile': PROFILE,
        'input_content': 'HIA assembly accepted by the current qualified selfhost compiler',
        'json_Core_frontend_included': False,
        'host_bootstrap_and_cold_custody_driver': True,
        'all_input_equivalence_proved': False, 'whole_native_delivery_qualified': False,
    }
    _publish_captured(output, executable_bytes, report, sourcekit=built.stdout)
    return executable


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for name in ('compiler', 'cold-report', 'output'):
        parser.add_argument('--' + name, type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(build(args.output.resolve(), args.compiler.resolve(), args.cold_report.resolve()))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

MAX_TOTAL = (1 << 61) - 1

# straight-line, checked u8 accesses. The order, full u64 width and layout are
# identical to the retained byte loops. No native-width memory primitive or
# foreign hash is introduced.
STREAM_WORD_HELPERS = r'''
def get(w:mutbuf, index:u64) -> u64:
    value = byte(w, index)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 1) << 8)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 2) << 16)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 3) << 24)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 4) << 32)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 5) << 40)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 6) << 48)
    value = value | (byte(w, index + 7) << 56)
    return value

def put(w:mutbuf, index:u64, value:u64) -> u64:
    store(w, index, value & 255)
    store(w, index + 1, (value >> 8) & 255)
    store(w, index + 2, (value >> 16) & 255)
    store(w, index + 3, (value >> 24) & 255)
    store(w, index + 4, (value >> 32) & 255)
    store(w, index + 5, (value >> 40) & 255)
    store(w, index + 6, (value >> 48) & 255)
    store(w, index + 7, (value >> 56) & 255)
    return 0

def source_program():

    op = byte(s, 0)
    if op == 0:
        if length(s) != 1:
            return 4294967293

        put(w, 1104, 1)
        put(w, 1176, {MAGIC})
        return 0
    if op != 1 and op != 2:
        return 4294967293
    if get(w, 1176) != {MAGIC} or get(w, 1104) != 1:
        return 4294967293
    total = get(w, 1088)
    used = get(w, 1096)
    if total > 2305843009213693951 or used != (total & 63):

    if op == 1:

        i = 1

                compress(w)
                used = 0
            i = i + 1
        put(w, 1088, total + count)
        put(w, 1096, used)
        return 0
    if length(s) != 1:
        return 4294967293
    store(w, 1112 + used, 128)
    used = used + 1
    while used != 56:
        if used == 64:
            compress(w)
            used = 0
        else:
            store(w, 1112 + used, 0)
            used = used + 1
    bits = total << 3
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        store(w, 1168 + i, (bits >> ((7 - i) * 8)) & 255)
        i = i + 1
    compress(w)
    put(w, 1104, 2)
    i = 0
    while i < 8:
        value = get(w, 1024 + i * 8)
        j = 0
        while j < 4:
            store(o, i * 4 + j, (value >> ((3 - j) * 8)) & 255)
            j = j + 1
        i = i + 1
    return 32

def compress(w:mutbuf) -> u64:
    i = 0
    while i < 16:
        value = 0
        j = 0
        while j < 4:
            value = (value << 8) | byte(w, 1112 + i * 4 + j)
            j = j + 1
        put(w, 512 + i * 8, value)
        i = i + 1
'''
    # Reuse exactly the independently qualified SHA schedule and round algebra;
    # only message delivery/padding and persistent state differ from one-shot.
    compression = BODY[BODY.index('        while i < 64:'):]
    source += ''.join(line[4:] + '\n' for line in compression.splitlines())
    for i, name in enumerate('abcdefgh'):
        source += f'    put(w, {1024 + i * 8}, (get(w, {1024 + i * 8}) + {name}) & 4294967295)\n'
    source += '    return 0\n'
    return (source + HELPERS[HELPERS.index('\ndef rotate'):HELPERS.index('\ndef get')]
            + STREAM_WORD_HELPERS)


def document():
    nodes = ast.parse(source_program()).body
    names = {node.name: 'f' + str(i) for i, node in enumerate(nodes)}
    signatures = {node.name: ([a.annotation.id for a in node.args.args], node.returns.id) for node in nodes}
    total = total_scalar_functions(nodes)
    functions = []
    for node in nodes:
        builder = Builder(node, names, signatures, total)
        builder.statements(node.body)
        functions.append({'name': names[node.name], 'params': [builder.param(v) for v in builder.params],
                          'returns': [builder.returns], 'effects': ['read', 'write', 'trap'],
                          'entry': 'b0', 'blocks': builder.blocks})
    return compact_authoring_cfg({'schema': 'hepta.hia.program.v8', 'module': 'sha256_stream', 'functions': functions})


def main():
    path = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'examples/hia_bootstrap/sha256_stream.hiaasm'
    path.write_text(render_assembly(document()))
    print(path.name, path.stat().st_size)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
